## What's changed

- Added Tater Tube Core playback endpoints so a paired Tater installation can resolve movies and series for an Echo screen and report play, pause, progress, stop, and completion state.
- Added purpose-built 720p and 480p Echo transcode profiles with H.264 video, stereo AAC audio, bounded frame rates and bitrates, and HDR-to-SDR tone mapping when needed.
- Added temporary, path-scoped stream grants for Core playback; Core credentials cannot browse arbitrary stream paths or act as general player or administrator tokens.
- Added resume-aware movie and episode selection, exact media probing, and viewing-history updates from screen playback.
- Updated the Tater Core pairing guidance and added regression coverage for profile limits, title matching, series selection, and scoped stream authorization.

Tater Tube Core v1.5.0 and a compatible Tater screen-satellite firmware are required for Echo-screen playback.
